tools.name: publish_html
tools.description: Publish a single self-contained HTML page (up to 512 KiB) without an account. It is public to anyone with the link and expires after 7 days. Returns { id, url, expiresAt (unix seconds), key, claimUrl }. Show the user url and claimUrl; keep key secret.

tools.name: update_html
tools.description: Replace the HTML of a page you published earlier with publish_html, using its id and key. The link and expiry stay the same.
